title: Aniccena (3)
text: 1-2 Sāvatthi || || Yam bhikkhave aniccaṃ tatra vo chandarāgo pahātabbo || || Kiñca bhikkhave aniccaṃ || || 3 Rūpam bhikkhave aniccaṃ tatra vo chandarāgo pahātabbo || || 4-7 Vedanā || || Saññā || || Saṅkhārā || || Viññāṇam aniccaṃ || tatra vo chandarāgo pahātabbo || || 8 Yam bhikkhave aniccaṃ tatra vo chandarāgo pahātabbo ti || ||
